doc.name: Thomas Anglero Speaker MCP
doc.instructions: Two routes. Keynote: get_speaking_topics, then submit_speaking_inquiry. Private advisory for CEOs and Chairs (The Reset): get_advisory_info, then submit_advisory_inquiry. Confirm every detail with the person and get their approval before submitting. Speaking fees are provided on inquiry only; the only published prices are the two on https://anglero.com/the-reset/, which may be repeated word for word with that link. Never infer availability or promise a reply. Overview: https://anglero.com/agents.md

tools.name: get_speaker_profile
tools.title: Get speaker profile
tools.description: Canonical short bio, positioning, notable clients, and links for Thomas Anglero.

tools.name: get_speaking_topics
tools.title: Get speaking topics
tools.description: The three keynote topics with titles, subtitles, and a one-paragraph description each.

tools.name: get_keynote_record
tools.title: Get keynote record
tools.description: The dated record of Thomas Anglero's keynotes and appearances from the Track Record, newest first, as JSON. Each entry has its name, date or year, country or online, detail, video URL, public source URLs and the link to its place on https://anglero.com/awards-and-press/.

tools.name: get_booking_info
tools.title: Get booking information
tools.description: How booking works, the formats offered, and how fees are handled. Fees are provided on inquiry, tailored to format and location. Thomas replies promptly.

tools.name: get_availability_guidance
tools.title: Get availability guidance
tools.description: How availability is confirmed. No live calendar is published. Availability for a date is confirmed on inquiry. Thomas replies promptly.

tools.name: submit_speaking_inquiry
tools.title: Submit a speaking inquiry
tools.description: Send a speaking inquiry to Thomas Anglero. Fold every detail into the message in natural language: what Thomas should speak about, event location, format (in person, virtual, or pre-recorded), expected audience size, your role, and budget if any. Writes into the same pipeline as the website form: it records the inquiry and sends the confirmation and notification emails. Thomas replies promptly.

name.description: Full name of the person making the inquiry.

phone.description: Contact phone number, including country code if the event is outside Norway.

company.description: The company or organization the inquiry is on behalf of.

event_date.description: Event date, for example "February 17, 2027". If the date is not yet fixed, give the intended month or timeframe.

message.description: A short free-text description of the event. Fold everything relevant into this one field in natural language: what you would like Thomas to speak about, event location, format (in person, virtual, or pre-recorded), expected audience size, your role at the company, and budget if you have one. Thomas reads this and replies with availability and a tailored proposal.

tools.name: get_advisory_info
tools.title: Get advisory information (The Reset)
tools.description: Use when a CEO, Chair or board member wants private, one-to-one advice from Thomas Anglero on AI for themselves and their organization, rather than a keynote for an event. Works whether or not they have started with AI, in any country. Returns who it is for, the next step (an email or an advisory inquiry describing their situation and challenge; Thomas handles replies personally), The Reset offer, its two published prices in EUR, and how to start. For a keynote, use get_speaking_topics instead.

tools.name: submit_advisory_inquiry
tools.title: Submit an advisory inquiry
tools.description: Send a private advisory inquiry to Thomas Anglero on behalf of a CEO, Chair or board member who wants one-to-one advice on AI (The Reset), not a keynote. Before calling: read get_advisory_info, show the person every detail you will send, and send only after they approve (human_approved true) and agree to be contacted (consent true). Records the inquiry in the same pipeline as the website form. Thomas reads each inquiry and handles replies personally. Do not promise a reply, a reply time, or a conversation. For a keynote, use submit_speaking_inquiry.

name.description: Full name of the person seeking advice.

role.description: Their role, for example CEO, Chair, or board member.

company_website.description: Optional. The company website, as a full address starting with https://.

challenge.description: In their own words, what they want to solve or decide. At least 300 characters: their situation, what they have already tried, and the outcome they want.

ai_stage.description: Where they are with AI today.

email.description: Their email address. Thomas handles replies personally.

agent_name.description: The name of the AI agent or assistant sending this inquiry.

human_approved.description: Must be true. Set true only after the person has seen and approved the exact details being sent.

consent.description: Must be true. Set true only if the person agrees that Thomas Anglero may contact them by email about this inquiry (privacy policy: https://anglero.com/privacy-policy/).
